verdict.rationale: The evidence shows mise can override a tool's backend (MISE_BACKENDS_<TOOL>) and install from explicit http: URLs. Neither documents configuring a private registry or mirror endpoint, and nothing in the pack covers credentials or authentication scoped to a registry. Per-tool URLs and backend overrides are adjacent features, not the private-registry-with-scoped-auth capability.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can point the manager at private registries or mirrors with scoped authentication
